title: Chapter 92
content_en: MGA: Chapter 92 – Chu Feng’s AncestryThe Chu family’s meeting concluded. Chu Feng and Chu Yuan returned to their current residence.“Father, I have something that I want to ask you.” As father and son were in one room by themselves, Chu Feng spoke to ask about something.“Feng'er, there’s no harm in speaking your mind about anything.” Chu Yuan looked at Chu Feng and his gaze was full of love and proudness.Chu Feng’s performance shocked him one time after the other.
